description: Counts ART clients with no subsequent clinical contact or ARV pick-up after their expected return date who were documented as deceased during the reporting quarter.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.return_visit_date >= :startDate
  AND a.return_visit_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND x.encounter_date > a.return_visit_date
        AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_arv_orders o
      WHERE o.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND o.voided = 0
        AND o.date_activated > a.return_visit_date
        AND o.date_activated < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_dim_person p
      WHERE p.person_id = a.patient_id
        AND p.dead = 1
        AND p.death_date >= :startDate
        AND p.death_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  );
